totalHits.description: Total number of organizations matching the request parameters.

description: Research private companies and investors with CB Insights: find and profile companies, read their funding, investments, exits, partners, leadership and revenue, get Mosaic and exit scores, generate scouting reports and ask ChatCBI. Fires on new funding rounds, investments, exits and business relationships.

cb_insights_new_business_relationship_tr.description: Runs when CB Insights records a new partnership, client, vendor or licensing deal for a company you follow.

parameters.description: 1 to 100 companies to follow, separated by commas, each given as its CB Insights ID, website, profile link or exact name.
parameters.name: companies

cb_insights_new_funding_round_trigger.description: Runs when CB Insights records a new funding round, acquisition or IPO for a company you follow.

parameters.description: 1 to 100 companies to follow, separated by commas, each given as its CB Insights ID, website, profile link or exact name.
parameters.name: companies

cb_insights_new_investment_trigger.description: Runs when CB Insights records a new investment by an investor you follow.

parameters.description: 1 to 100 investors to follow, separated by commas, each given as its CB Insights ID, website, profile link or exact name.
parameters.name: investors

cb_insights_new_portfolio_exit_trigger.description: Runs when a company backed by an investor you follow is acquired or goes public.

parameters.description: 1 to 100 investors to follow, separated by commas, each given as its CB Insights ID, website, profile link or exact name.
parameters.name: investors

cb_insights_newly_funded_company_trigger.description: Runs when a company matching your search records new funding in CB Insights. Fill in at least one field.

parameters.description: Words to match in company names and descriptions, such as ai agents.
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.description: A CB Insights market name, or part of one, such as AI.
parameters.name: market

parameters.description: Where the company is based, such as United States.
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: A CB Insights sector, such as Healthcare or Finance.
parameters.name: sector

parameters.description: Only this kind of round, such as Seed / Angel or Series A.
parameters.name: round_type
